verdict.rationale: Docs confirm PTO policy setup with policy name, start/end dates, policy type, and timecard sync, plus a clear setup flow (Time Off > Policies > Add policy), which supports payroll sync via timecard integration. However, there is no explicit evidence of accrual rule configuration or an approval workflow for PTO requests tied to policies. Missing for 10: accrual rate/rules configuration details, explicit approval workflow mechanics, and confirmation that approvals automatically flow into payroll processing.
